page.overview:
Who is Arjun Maini?

= Arjun Maini = Arjun Maini (born 10 December 1997) is an Indian racing driver currently competing in the Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) with Mercedes-AMG Team HRT. He is known for his diverse career across single-seaters and endurance racing, including stints in GP3, FIA Formula 2, the European Le Mans Series, and the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Maini also served as a development driver for the Haas F1 Team between 2017 and 2018.

He is the son of Indian industrialist Gautam Maini and the older brother of Formula 2 race winner and Alpine F1 reserve driver Kush Maini. Arjun was one of India’s most promising junior drivers in the 2010s and became the first Indian to race full-time in the DTM.

Born in Bangalore, Karnataka, Arjun Maini began karting at the age of five and quickly made a name for himself in domestic championships. He won several national karting titles in India and progressed to the international stage, competing in Europe. In 2011, Maini finished runner-up in the Malaysian Junior Karting Championship and continued to race in the Rotax Max Asia and British karting series before transitioning to single-seaters.

Maini made his single-seater debut in 2013, competing in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JK_Tyre_National_Racing_Championship JK Tyre Racing Series] in India, where he took multiple wins. In 2014, he moved to Europe full-time to contest the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_BRDC_Formula_4_Championship BRDC Formula 4 Championship,] finishing runner-up to George Russell with three wins and nine podiums. That performance earned him a test with the Ferrari Driver Academy and caught the attention of international teams.
